title: One Thing, Then the Next
label: ch:ja-one-thing-then-the-next
canDo: I can tell what I did in order, joining actions with the -te form (okite, kao o aratte, dekakemashita), say what came after what (tabete kara; sore kara; soshite), and recognise 月 in 月日.

payoff.summary: Complete JA-R252-one-thing-then-the-next: tell a morning in order, one action after another.
